## Checklist

- [ ] **Tokens used.** No hard-coded colours; every colour is a semantic token from `@vineethbangera/tokens`. (`pnpm lint` catches most cases, but not a wrong token.)
- [ ] **Stories added.** Every new state, variant or slot has a story, and the Usage page is updated if guidance changed.
- [ ] **Accessibility checked.** Story tests pass in Light and Dark, and I tried it with a keyboard. For new interactions, I also tried a screen reader.
- [ ] **Changeset added.** Describes the change for the release notes, or this PR doesn't change a published package.
